headline: Hearing request by Art Dzhanaev for 2 Chase Street, and discussion of the draft Bodyworks Regulation.
summary: The agenda includes a hearing request from Art Dzhanaev about the absence of an inspection report for 2 Chase Street. It also includes a discussion and update on the draft Bodyworks Regulation.
items: Discussion and update on the draft Board of Health Bodyworks Regulation.
Hearing request by Art Dzhanaev for 2 Chase Street under 105 CMR 410.800(B)(2), about the absence of an inspection report for the September 16, 2026, joint site inspection of 2 Chase Street.
Public health announcements, reports, and updates, including the Public Health Nurse Report, Health Agent Report, Administrative Report, and Council Liaison Updates.
New business and scheduling of future agenda items.
location: City Hall Annex, first floor large conference room, and via Zoom
